content.title: Free account upgrades to Pro from the dashboard
content.intent: Prove that an eligible Free account can trigger the dashboard upgrade in place, receive same-view success confirmation, and complete the change with no payment-processing step.
content.technique_notes: Applied Equivalence partitioning to the source-defined eligible account partition (`free` can upgrade, target plan is `pro`). Applied State / flow to the in-dashboard action sequence and Negative / error to the forbidden payment-step promise. No covering array was needed because there were no independent user inputs or roles to combine; the risk-judged interaction strength would otherwise be 3 because the flow changes paid-plan entitlement.
